replacements.IA clásica vs IA Generativa: cinco difer: Classical AI vs Generative AI: five differences
replacements.Confundirlas lleva a decisiones equivoca: Confusing them leads to bad decisions. Knowing how they differ is the basis for choosing the right technology.
replacements.aria-label=\"Cinco diferencias ML vs Gen: aria-label="Five differences between ML and GenAI"
replacements.Un clasificador de fraude devuelve \"fra: A fraud classifier returns "fraud / not fraud". An LLM can return any text response. That difference has consequences for everything that comes after it.
replacements.Dado el mismo input, el mismo modelo pro: Given the same input, the same model always produces the same output. The behaviour is reproducible.
replacements.Sistemas donde la trazabilidad y la audi: Systems where traceability and auditability matter. Production with a reproducibility requirement.
replacements.Dado el mismo prompt, el modelo puede pr: Given the same prompt, the model can produce different responses. "Temperature" controls how much variability there is.
replacements.Creatividad, exploración, generación de: Creativity, exploration, and generation of variants. A risk in critical decisions that require reproducibility.
replacements.El determinismo de ML es una ventaja don: ML determinism is an advantage where traceability matters. GenAI variability is a feature in creativity and a risk in critical decisions.
replacements.Árboles, regresión logística: directamen: Trees and logistic regression: directly interpretable. "Rejected because income < X and debt ratio > Y."
replacements.SHAP y LIME calculan la contribución de: SHAP and LIME calculate each variable's contribution to each specific decision. Established techniques.
replacements.El proceso interno es opaco. El modelo g: The internal process is opaque. The model generates fluent text that appears reasoned, but the "why" is not accessible.
replacements.El síntoma más visible de esa opacidad:: The most visible symptom of that opacity: the model produces the most probable continuation even when it is not true.
replacements.Alucinacion: el modelo no miente — produ: Hallucination: the model does not lie — it produces the statistically most probable continuation. It is a consequence of the generation mechanism, not an eliminable defect.
replacements.Se calculan con datos etiquetados, se re: They are calculated on labelled data and reproduced without ambiguity. The criterion for "works" is clear.
replacements.Las métricas automáticas clásicas son ap: Classical automatic metrics are poor approximations. Practice combines a model-based evaluator, human review, and task-specific metrics.
replacements.La evaluación es el cuello de botella de: Evaluation is the bottleneck in most GenAI projects. Building the evaluation system before the system itself is the most underestimated practice in the field.
replacements.Deriva de datos: el mundo cambia, el mod: Data drift: the world changes, the model does not. Performance degrades silently.
replacements.Modelo que funciona bien en pruebas pero: A model that works well in tests but fails in production when patterns change.
replacements.Inputs manipulados para engañar al model: Inputs manipulated to fool the model (adversarial examples).
replacements.Decisiones automatizadas (GDPR Art. 22,: Automated decisions (GDPR Art. 22, high-risk AI Act).
replacements.Alucinaciones, sesgos amplificados, sali: Hallucinations, amplified biases, unpredictable outputs. Fluent text that appears correct but is not.
replacements.El usuario interpreta fluidez lingüístic: The user interprets linguistic fluency as factual reliability. They are not the same.
replacements.Prompt injection: instrucciones ocultas: Prompt injection: hidden instructions in user-supplied text that manipulate the model.
replacements.Contenido generado, derechos de autor, d: Generated content, copyright, deepfakes, dissemination of false information.
replacements.Ninguna familia es más segura en abstrac: Neither family is safer in the abstract. The risks are different and require different mitigations.
